name: 20-Minute Chicken Creole

ingredients.name: skinless chicken breast, cut into thin strips
tinned whole peeled tomatoes, chopped, with juice

steps: Spray a frying pan and get it hot over high heat.
Stir-fry the chicken strips for 3-5 minutes, then turn the heat down.
Add the tomatoes, chilli sauce, capsicum, celery, onion, garlic, herbs, chilli flakes and salt and bring to the boil.
Drop to a simmer, cover and cook for 10 minutes.
description: A quick Southern-style chicken and capsicum stew in a spicy tomato sauce, cooked with no added fat.
whoItsFor: Anyone in a calorie deficit who wants a lean, high-protein dinner in about half an hour.
tips: Spoon it over brown rice on heavy training days for extra carbs.

steps: Put the stock, mushrooms, ginger, spring onion, soy sauce and sesame oil in a wide, shallow pan, bring to the boil and simmer for 2-3 minutes.
Add the salmon, cover tightly and poach on low for 4-5 minutes, until it flakes in the thickest part (63°C).
Serve each piece of salmon with a quarter of the broth.

name: Crumbed Baked Fish
steps: Heat the oven to 245°C.
Sprinkle the fish with lemon juice, then pat dry.
Mix the buttermilk, hot sauce and garlic in a bowl; mix the pepper, salt and onion powder through the cornflake crumbs on a plate.
Dip each fillet in the buttermilk, press into the crumbs on both sides and rest briefly so the coating sticks.
Lay on a lightly oiled baking dish and bake on the middle shelf for 20 minutes without turning.
Cut into six portions and serve with lemon wedges.
description: Crisp, oven-baked crumbed fish with almost no added fat - a lean take on fish and chips.
whoItsFor: Anyone wanting a big hit of lean protein for very few calories.
tips: Firm white fish such as flathead, ling or basa all work well.

steps: Heat the oven to 200°C.
Whisk the sour cream, dill, spring onion, mustard and lemon juice into a sauce.
Place the salmon skin-side down on a sprayed tray, season with garlic powder and pepper, then spread with the sauce.
Bake for about 20 minutes, until opaque in the centre and flaky (63°C). Serve straight away.

whoItsFor: Lifters and anyone after a high-protein, low-carb dinner rich in omega-3s.

Lay the fillets in the dish.
Mix everything else except the garnish and spoon it evenly over the fish.
Bake uncovered for 15-20 minutes until the fish flakes, then garnish with parsley and lemon.
description: White fish baked under a fresh tomato, olive, garlic and lime topping - Mediterranean flavours, minimal effort.
whoItsFor: Anyone wanting a low-carb, dairy-free and gluten-free fish dinner.

medium carrots, peeled and cut into thin sticks

steps: Melt the butter in a wide pan and gently cook the leek and carrot for 3-5 minutes until starting to soften.
Add the potato, stock, parsley, salt and pepper, bring to the boil, then simmer 10-12 minutes until the vegetables are just tender.
Lay the cod on top, cover tightly and cook on low for about 5 minutes until white and flaky (63°C).
Serve each fillet with a share of the vegetables and broth.
description: Cod gently braised on a bed of leek, carrot and new potatoes in a light broth.
whoItsFor: People in a calorie deficit who want a filling, high-volume fish meal.
tips: Ling, hake or blue-eye are good substitutes for cod.

ingredients.name: skinless chicken legs or thighs (4 legs split, or 8 thighs)

steps: Heat the oven to 180°C.
Brown the mushrooms in the oil in an ovenproof pan for 3-5 minutes, then add the leek, potato, celery and onions and soften for another 3-5 minutes.
Pour in the stock, bring to the boil, add the chicken, cover and bake for about 20 minutes until tender (75°C).
Lift out the chicken, return the pan to the stove and boil the liquid; stir in the herbs and lemon juice.
Mix the cornflour into the sour cream, whisk into the sauce, bring back to the boil and take off the heat.
Season and spoon about a cup of vegetables and sauce over each serve of chicken.

tips: Thighs stay juicier than breast here and still keep the fat modest with the skin off.

ingredients.name: boneless, skinless chicken (breast or leg), cubed

steps: Spray a heavy frying pan and brown the chicken in batches over medium heat.
Transfer the chicken to a lidded casserole with the celery, tomato, chillies and garlic.
Splash cold water into the hot pan, scrape up the browned bits and pour this into the casserole.
Add just enough water to cover, put the lid on and simmer for about 1½ hours until thick and very tender.
Season with pepper before serving.

tips: Roast mild long green chillies under the grill and peel them for a smoky flavour.

Add the chicken and stir-fry 5-10 minutes until cooked through.
Stir in the tomato sauce, stock, lemon juice, cumin, bay leaves, water and sultanas.
Cover, lower the heat and simmer 10 minutes.
Remove the bay leaves and top with coriander, capers and olives.

whoItsFor: Anyone after a flavour-packed, lower-calorie dinner that is still high in protein.

medium zucchini, finely shredded or diced
fresh basil, cut into thin strips (or 1 tsp dried)

steps: Cook the pasta in a big pot of boiling water for the shortest time on the packet, then drain and rinse under cold water for about 3 minutes.
Put the vegetables and chickpeas in a large bowl and season with basil, salt and pepper.
Add the cooled pasta.
Whisk the oil and vinegar, pour over and toss gently.
Divide into four and top each bowl with 2 tablespoons of parmesan.

ingredients.name: frozen puréed butternut pumpkin (or steamed, blended fresh pumpkin)

steps: Thaw the pumpkin in a covered dish in the microwave on medium for 5-10 minutes.
Peel and shred the apples; keep ¼ cup aside for topping.
Warm the oil in a large saucepan and cook the rest of the apple for about 5 minutes until soft.
Stir in the pumpkin and spice, then add the evaporated milk about half a cup at a time, stirring after each.
Season, heat until just about to boil, then ladle into bowls and top with the reserved apple.

Toss all the salad ingredients together (it can be made up to 2 hours ahead).
Grill the tuna on high for 3-4 minutes a side until it flakes (63°C).
Serve each steak on a cup of salad.

whoItsFor: Anyone wanting a lean, 30g-protein dinner that is light on carbs but filling.
tips: Add a side of quinoa seasoned with paprika and cumin for more carbs.

Thread three chicken cubes and three pineapple pieces alternately onto each skewer.
Mix the sauce ingredients and split into two bowls - one for basting raw chicken, one kept clean for serving.
Grill the skewers 3-5 minutes a side, basting every couple of minutes from the basting bowl; discard what's left of it.
Finish in a 180°C oven until cooked through (75°C), then brush with the clean sauce to serve.
description: Sweet-and-salty glazed chicken and pineapple skewers off the grill.

Spray the pan, cook the onion 3 minutes, then add garlic and broccoli for 2 more minutes.
Return the chicken, add the pasta sauce, cayenne and salt, cover and simmer about 4 minutes.

Cover, bring to the boil, then simmer at least an hour until the lentils are soft.

Add the capsicum, cover and cook 5 minutes, stirring now and then.
Stir in the garlic, cumin and oregano for 1 minute.

Brush with the rest of the sauce, cover with foil and bake at 180°C for 30 minutes.
